title: CYBRIK investigation evidence bundle strict-compatible proposal v1
description: PROPOSED v0.1.1 strict-compatible revision of the accepted cybrik.investigation-bundle.v1 v0.1.0 shape. It preserves the accepted required fields, properties, limits, references, and runtime marking obligations exactly. The accepted v0.1.0 is fully JSON Schema 2020-12 conformant and is NOT being corrected for spec validity: its generated_by.allOf[1] is the bare subschema {"required":["tenant_id"]}, which the 2020-12 specification permits and which only Ajv's optional strict mode rejects (strictRequired/strictTypes house style, not a specification requirement). The single semantic-neutral change here adds an explicit "type": "object" to generated_by.allOf[1] and writes a local "properties"."tenant_id" subschema into that same branch. That tenant_id subschema did not previously exist in allOf[1]; it is newly written here and is semantically redundant, because allOf[0]'s actor $ref already constrains tenant_id to the identical cybrik.common-defs.v1 tenantId primitive. The revision therefore narrows, widens, and removes nothing, and satisfies only the stricter Ajv strict-mode house style. It does not modify, replace, deprecate, or status-flip the accepted v0.1.0 bytes. Adoption/supersession requires a separate explicit Founder acceptance decision. NOT ACCEPTED, NOT IMPLEMENTED.

investigation_id.description: Parent cybrik.investigation.v1.investigation_id. Required — a bundle is always investigation-scoped (ADR-0006 E6).

status.description: Snapshot of the parent investigation's status at bundle-generation time.

claims.description: Digest-bound references to this investigation's cybrik.claim.v1 entries. MUST be non-empty — an investigation with no grounded findings still yields at least one 'abstained' claim, never a silent empty bundle.

evidence.description: Digest-bound references to this investigation's cybrik.evidence.v1 entries.

limitations.description: Free-text scope/coverage gaps for this bundle (evidence-first triage instead of summary prose — roadmap Week 2).

generated_by.description: Authenticated actor (typically a service) that generated the bundle. Written only by authenticated service code.

data_marking.description: Authoritative marking of the bundle. MUST be >= the union of the markings of every referenced claim/evidence (control-enforced non-downgrade).

digest.description: Content digest of this bundle's own (claims, evidence, status, generated_at) tuple, enabling structural replay/integrity verification (roadmap W2).
